articles.text: Buzima.

articles.heading: Umuyobozi mukuru ashyirwaho n'Inteko y’Ishami bisabwe n'Inama nshingwabikorwa kandi hagakurikizwa amabwiriza ashobora
articles.text:
gushyirwaho n'Inteko y’Ishami. Haseguriwe
uburenganzira bw' Inama nshingwabikorwa,
Umuyobozi mukuru ni we muyobozi wa tekiniki
n'imiyoborere by'Ishami ry'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima.

articles.heading: Umuyobozi mukuru ni we unaba ku bw’iyo nshingano Umunyamabanga w'Inteko y’Ishami, w' Inama nshingwabikorwa, wa komisiyo na
articles.text:
komite zose z'Ishami ry'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima n'inama
zitumizwa na ryo. Ashobora guha abandi izo
nshingano

articles.heading: Umuyobozi mukuru cyangwa umuhagarariye ashobora gushyiraho uburyo hakurikijwe amasezerano agirana n’ibihugu bigize Ishami,
articles.text:
butuma mu kuzuza inshingano ze akorana mu
buryo butazigiye n’amashami anyuranye ya za
minisiteri cyane cyane ubuyobozi bushinzwe
ubuzima n'imiryango ishinzwe ubuzima mu
gihugu, iya Leta cyangwa itegamiye kuri Leta
Ashobora gushyiraho imibanire itaziguye
n'imiryango mpuzamahanga ikora ibikorwa biri
mu bubasha bw'Ishami ry'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima. Amenyesha
abakorera mu turere ibibazo byose bijyanye na
zone bakoreramo.

articles.heading: Umuyobozi mukuru ategura kandi agaha Inama nshingwabikorwa raporo y'umutungo n'ingengo y'imari iteganyinjwe y'Ishami ry'Umuryango
articles.text: w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima.

articles.heading: Umuyobozi mukuru ashyiraho Umukozi mu bunyamabanga hakurikijwe amategeko agenga abakozi ashyirwaho n'Inteko y’Ishami
articles.text:
Igishingirwaho gisumba ibindi mu gushaka
abakozi ni uguharanira ko ubushobozi,
ubunyangamugayo n'imyitwarire
mpuzamahanga y'ubunyamabanga byitabwaho
ku rwego ruhanitse. Gushaka abakozi bashya
kandi hashingiwe ku merekezo y'isi bihabwa
agaciro mu buryo bwagutse bushoboka.

articles.heading: Imiterere y'akazi k'abakozi b'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku buzima, iyo bishoboka, ikurikiza iy'amashami
articles.text: y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye.

articles.heading: Mu kuzuza inshingano zabo, Umuyobozi mukuru n'abakozi ntibakenera cyangwa ngo bahabwe amabwiriza n'igihugu icyo aricyo
articles.text:
cyose cyangwa urwego urwo ari rwo rwose
rutari urw'Ishami. Birinda gukora igikorwa icyo
ari cyo cyose cyakwangize isura y'umwanya
wabo nk'abakozi mpuzamahanga. Buri gihugu
kigize Ishami, ku ruhande rwacyo, cyiyemeza
kubaha imiterere yihariye mpuzamahanga
y'Umuyobozi mukuru n'abakozi kandi
ntigishake kubinjirira.
UMUTWE WA VIII: KOMISIYO

articles.heading: Inama ishyiraho Komisiyo Inteko y’Ishami ishobora kugena, ibyibwirije cyangwa bisabwe n'Umuyobozi mukuru, kandi ishobora
articles.text:
gushyiraho izindi Komisiyo bigaragara ko
zikenewe hagamijwe gukora ikigamijwe kiri mu
bubasha bw'Ishami ry'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima.

articles.heading: Inama isuzuma buri gihe kandi nibura rimwe mu mwaka, niba ari ngombwa kugumishaho komisiyo
Inama nshingwabikorwa ishobora gushyiraho Komisiyo zihuriweho cyangwa zivanze n'indi miryango cyangwa igakora ku buryo Ishami
articles.text:
rigiramo uruhare. Ishobora gukora ku buryo
ishami rihagararirwa mu makomisiyo
yashyizweho n’indi miryango.
UMUTWE WA IX: INTEKO

articles.heading: Inteko y’Ishami cyangwa Inama nshingwabikorwa bishobora gutumiza inama z'ibihugu, inama rusange, iza tekiniki cyangwa
articles.text:
izindi zose zihariye kugira ngo zige ku kibazo
kiri mu bubasha bw'Ishami ry'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima kandi
igahagararira muri izo nteko z’imiryango
mpuzamahanga byemejwe na Leta bireba, mu
nama zaryo no mu miryango mpuzamahanga
y’imiryango yo mu gihugu imwe n’imwe yaba
iyo iya ari iya Leta cyangwa itari yo. Uburyo
bw’uko guhagararirwa bugenwa n'Inteko
y’Ishami cyangwa Inama nshingwabikorwa.

articles.heading: Inama nshingwabikorwa igena uguhagararirwa kw’Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima mu nama ibona ko Ishami rifitemo
articles.text:
inyungu.
UMUTWE WA X: ICYICARO

articles.heading: Aho Icyicaro cy'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima kijya hagenwa n'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku
articles.text:
Buzima rimaze kugisha inama Umuryango
w'Abibumbye.
UMUTWE WA XI: UBWUMVIKANE BWO
MU KARERE

articles.heading: (a) Igihe cyose Inteko y’Ishami igena ahantu yifuza gushyira umuryango wo mu karere
articles.text:
(b) Byemejwe ku bwiganze bw'amajwi y'
ibuhugu bigize ishami biri muri buri gace
kagenwe, Inteko y’Ishami ishobora gushyiraho
umuryango wo mu karere kugira ngo wuzuze
inshingano zihariye muri ako gace. Muri buri
gace ntihagomba kuba umuryango wo mu karere
urenze umwe.

articles.heading: Buri muryango wo mu karere ni igice kigize Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima hakurikijwe aya Masezerano
articles.text: awushyiraho.

articles.heading: Buri muryango mu yo mu karere ugizwe na Komite yo mu karere n'ibiro byo mu karere
Komite zo mu karere zigizwe n'abahagarariye ibihugu bigize Ishami by’ibanze n'ibindi byo muri ako karere. Intara cyangwa amatsinda
articles.text:
y'intara muri ako gace, bidafite inshingano
z'imibanire mpuzamahanga kandi zitari mu
bigize Ishami, bifite uburenganzira bwo
guhagararirwa muri izo komite no kuzigiramo
uruhare. Imiterere n'ingano y'uburenganzira
n'inshingano by'izo ntara cyangwa ayo matsinda
y'intara bigenwa n'Inteko y’Ishami rigishije
inama igihugu cyangwa urundi rwego rufite
inshingano z'imibanire mpuzamahanga y'izo
ntara n'ibindi bihugu bigize Ishami mu karere.

articles.heading: Komite zo mu karere ziterana iyo bikenewe kandi zigena ahantu habera buri nama
Komite zo mu karere zitora amategeko ngengamikorere yazo
Imirimo ya Komite zo mu karere ni
articles.text:
(a) gutegura amabwiriza arebana n’ibibazo
bijyanye gusa n’akarere;
(b) kugenzura ibikorwa by'ibiro byo mu karere;
(c) gusaba ibiro biri mu karere inama za tekiniki
ndetse n'akandi kazi cyangwa ubushakashatsi ku
bibazo by'ubuzima, igitekerezo cya Komite yo
mu karere hagamijwe kugera ku ntego y'Ishami
ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima
mu karere;
(d) kugirana ubufatanye na Komite zo mu karere
z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye hamwe n'indi
miryango mpuzamahanga ishamikiyeho ndetse
n'indi miryango mpuzamahanga yo mu karere
ifite inyungu ihuriyeho n'Ishami ry'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima;
(e) kugira inama Ishami ry'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima, binyuze ku
Muyobozi mukuru, ku bibazo mpuzamahanga
byerekeye ubuzima bifitiye akamaro akarere;
(f) gusaba ibihugu byo mu karere kongera
ingengo y'imari niba iyatanzwe n'Ishami
ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima
muri ako karere idahagije kugira ngo hakorwe
imirimo iteganyijwe mu karere;
(g) indi mirimo yose ishobora guhabwa Komite
yo mu karere bikozwe n'Inteko y’Ishami, Inama
nshingwabikorwa cyangwa Umuyobozi
mukuru.

articles.heading: Bitegetswe n'Umuyobozi mukuru w'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima, ibiro byo mu karere ni rwo rwego rw'ubuyobozi
articles.text:
bwa Komite yo mu karere. Igomba gushyira mu
bikorwa, hashingiwe ku bushobozi bw’akarere
ibyemezo by’Inteko y’Ishami.

articles.heading: Umuyobozi w'ibiro byo mu karere ni Umuyobozi wo mu karere ushyirwaho n'Inama byumvikanyweho na Komite yo mu karere
Abakozi b'ibiro byo mu karere bashyirwaho hakurikijwe ingingo zishyirwa mu masezerano y’ubwumvikane hagati y'Umuyobozi mukuru
articles.text: n'Umuyobozi wo mu karere.

articles.heading: Umuryango ushinzwe ubuzima ku mugabane wa Amerika, uhagarariwe n'Ibiro bishinzwe ubuzima byo kuri uwo mugabane n'inama
articles.text:
zerekeye ubuzima, n'indi miryango ishinzwe
ubuzima yo mu karere ihuza ibihugu isanzweho
mbere yo gushyira umukono kuri aya
Masezerano, bizashyirwa mu Ishami
ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima.
Kubihuriza hamwe bizakorwa igihe cyose
bishoboka binyuze mu bwumvikane bw'inzego
zibifitiye ububasha bugaragajwe n'imiryango
bireba.
UMUTWE WA XII: INGENGO Y'IMARI
N'AMAFARANGA AKORESHWA

articles.heading: Umuyobozi mukuru ategura kandi akoherereza Inama nshingwabikorwa ingengo y'imari iteganyijwe y'Ishami ry'Umuryango
articles.text:
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima. Inama
nshingwabikorwa isuzuma kandi ikoherereza
Inteko y’Ishami iyo ngengo y'imari iteganyijwe,
iherekejwe n’ibyifuzonama ibona ko bikwiye.

articles.heading: Haseguriwe amasezerano hagati y'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye, Inteko y’Ishami
articles.text:
isuzuma kandi ikemeza ingengo y'imari
iteganyijwe kandi ikagena uko ikoreshwa
n'ibihugu bigize Ishami hakurikijwe uburyo
bushyirwaho n'Inteko y’Ishami.

articles.heading: Inteko y’Ishami cyangwa Inama nshingwabikorwa mu izina ry'Inteko y’Ishami ishobora kwemera no gutanga impano n'imirage
articles.text:
bihabwa Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye
ryita ku Buzima ku buryo ibisabwa bijyanye
n'izo mpano cyangwa imirage biba byemewe
n'Inteko y’Ishami cyangwa Inama
nshingwabikorwa kandi ajyanye n'Intego na
gahunda z'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye
ryita ku Buzima.

articles.heading: Ikigega cyihariye, gikoreshwa mu bushishozi bw'Inama nshingwabikorwa, gishyirwaho kugira ngo kifashishwe mu gihe hari ibyihutiwe
articles.text:
ndetse no mu bihe byose bidateganyijwe.
UMUTWE WA XIII: GUTORA

articles.heading: Buri gihugu kigize Ishami gifite ijwi rimwe mu Nteko ‘Ishami
(a) Ibyemezo by'Inteko y’Ishami ku bibazo by'ingenzi bitorwa ku bw2/3 by'ibihugu bigize Ishami byitabiriye kandi bitora. Ibyo bibazo
articles.text:
birimo: iyemezwa ry'amasezerano
mpuzamahanga cyangwa andi masezerano;
kwemera amasezerano ahuza Ishami
ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku buzima
n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye, imiryango n’ibigo
bihuriweho n'ibihugu mu gukurikiza ingingo ya
69, iya 70 n'iya 72; ivugururwa ry'aya
Masezerano.
(b) Ibyemezo ku bindi bibazo, birimo kugena
ibindi byiciro by'ibibazo bigomba gufatwaho
icyemezo ku bwiganze bwa 2/3 byemezwa ku
bwiganze busanzwe bw’ibihugu bigize Ishami
byitabiriye kandi batora.
(c) Itora mu Nama nshingwabikorwa na
Komisiyo by'Ishami ku bibazo bifite imiterere
isa rikorwa hashingiwe ku bika (a) na (b) by'iyi
ngingo.
UMUTWE WA XIV: RAPORO
ZITANGWA N'IBIHUGU

articles.heading: Buri gihugu giha raporo y'umwaka Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima yerekeye ingamba zafashwe n'aho ibikorwa
articles.text:
bigeze byo guteza imbere ubuzima bw'abaturage
bacyo.

articles.heading: Buri gihugu kigize Ishami gitanga raporo yerekeye ingamba cyafashe mu gushyira mu bikorwa ibyifuzonama cyahawe n'Ishami
articles.text:
ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima
ndetse n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga, andi
amasezerano n'amategeko.

articles.heading: Buri gihugu kimenyesha ku buryo bwihuse Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima amategeko, amabwiriza, raporo zemewe
articles.text:
n'ibarurishamibare by’ingenzi bijyanye
n'ubuzima kandi byatangajwe muri icyo gihugu.

articles.heading: Buri gihugu gitanga raporo y'ibarurishamibare n'iy'ibyorezo mu buryo buteganywa n'Inteko y’Ishami
Bisabwe n’Inama, buri gihugu cyohereza mu gihe bishoboka amakuru yose y’inyongera ajyanye n’ubuzima
articles.text:
UMUTWE WA XV: UBUBASHA
BW'AMATEGEKO, UBURENGANZIRA
BWIHARIYE N'UBUDAHANGARWA

articles.heading: Ishami rigira ku butaka bwa buri gihugu kigize Ishami, ububasha bw’amategeko bwa ngombwa kugira ngo rigere ku ntego yaryo kandi rikore
articles.text: imirimo yaryo.

articles.heading: (a) Ishami rigira ku butaka bwa buri gihugu kigize Ishami uburenganzira bwihariye n'ubudahangarwa bya ngombwa kugira ngo
articles.text:
rigere ku ntego yaryo kandi rikore imirimo
yaryo.
(b) Abahagarariye ibihugu bigize Ishami, abantu
bashyirwaho kugira ngo babe abagize Inama
n’abakozi mu bya tekiniki n’ubuyobozi
b’Ishami bagira uburenganzira bwihariye
n'ubudahanganrwa bya ngombwa mu gukora mu
bwisanzure imirimo yabo ijyanye.

articles.heading: Ubwo bubasha bw'amategeko, uburenganzira bwihariye n'ubudahangarwa bisobanurwa mu masezerano yihariye ategurwa n'Ishami
articles.text:
ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima
ubigiyeho inama n'Umunyamabanga mukuru
w'Umuryango w'Abibumbye kandi agakorwa
hagati y'ibihugu bigize Ishami.
UMUTWE WA XVI: IMIBANIRE N'INDI
MIRYANGO

articles.heading: Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima rishamikiye ku Muryango w'Abibumbye nka rimwe mu mashami yawo
articles.text:
ateganywa mu ngingo ya 57 y'Amasezerano
mpuzamahanga ashyiraho Umuryango
w'Abibumbye. Amasezerano ashyiraho
imibanire hagati y'Ishami ry'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima n'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye agomba kwemezwa ku bwiganze
bwa 2/3 by’Inteko y’Ishami.

articles.heading: Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima rigirana imibanire myiza kandi rikagirana ubufatanye n'indi miryango ribona ko
articles.text:
ikenewe. Amasezerano yose rigirana n'iyo
miryango yemezwa ku bwiganze bwa 2/3 by’
Inteko y’Ishami.

articles.heading: Ku birebana n'ibibazo biri mu bubasha bwaryo, Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima rishobora gushyiraho uburyo bukwiye
articles.text:
bwo kujya inama no kugirana ubufatanye
n'imiryango mpuzamahanga itegamiye kuri Leta
n'imiryango ikorera mu gihugu, iya Leta
n'itegamiye kuri Leta, byemejwe n'igihugu
bireba.

articles.heading: Haseguriwe ko byemezwa na 2/3 by’ Inteko y’ishami, Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima rishobora gukura ku yindi
articles.text:
miryango mpuzamahanga cyangwa ibigo bifite
intego n'ibikorwa biri mu bubasha bwaryo
imirimo, umutungo n'inshingano zagombye
kuba izaryo hashingiwe ku masezerano
mpuzamahanga cyangwa ku bwumvikane
bwemewe bwakozwe hagati y’inzego zibifitiye
ububasha z’imiryango bireba.
UMUTWE WA XVII: IVUGURURWA

articles.heading: Inyandiko z'ivugururwa ryifujwe kuri aya Masezerano zimenyeshwa ibihugu bigize Ishami n’Umuyobozi mukuru nibura mbere y'amezi
articles.text:
atandatu zitarasuzumwa n'Inteko y’Ishami.
Amavugururwa atangira gukurikizwa ku bihugu
byose bigize Ishami iyo yemejwe na 2/3
by'Inteko y’Ishami kandi akemerwa na 2/3
by'ibihugu bigize Ishami hakurikijwe
amategeko nshinga yabyo.
UMUTWE WA XVIII: ISOBANURWA

articles.heading: Inyandiko zo mu Gishinwa, Icyongereza, Igifaransa, Ikirusiya n'Icyesupanyolo zose ni mpamo
Ikibazo cyose cyangwa amakimbirane arebana n'isobanurwa cyangwa ikurikizwa ry'aya Masezerano adakemuriwe mu nzira
articles.text:
z’ubwumvikane cyangwa n'Inteko y’Ishami
ashyikirizwa Urukiko mpuzamahanga
hakurikijwe Amategeko arugenga; keretse
impande zirebwa zumvikanye ku bundi buryo
bwo kuyakemura.

articles.heading: Ribyemerewe n'Inteko rusange y'Umuryango w'Abibumbye cyangwa ribyemerewe hakurikijwe amasezerano yagiranywe hagati
articles.text:
y'Ishami ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku
buzima n'Umuryango w'Abibumbye, Ishami
ry'Umuryango w'Abibumbye ryita ku buzima
rishobora gusaba inama Urukiko
mpuzamahanga rw'ubutabera yerekeye ikibazo
cyose kijyanye n'amategeko kiri mu bubasha
bwaryo.

articles.heading: Umuyobozi mukuru ashobora guhagararira Ishami mu Rukiko mu buryo ubwo aribwo bwose burebana n’isaba iryo ari ryo ryose ry’
articles.text:
igitekerezo gitanga inama. Afata ingamba za
ngombwa kugira ngo ashyikirize urukiko
ikibazo, harimo iza ngombwa zo kugaragaza
ingingo z'ibitekerezo binyuranye byavuzwe ku
kibazo.
UMUTWE WA XIX: IGIHE
AMASEZERANO ATANGIRA
GUKURIKIZWA

articles.heading: Haseguriwe ibiteganwa n'Umutwe wa III, aya Masezerano akomeza kwemererwa gushyirwaho umukono cyangwa kwemerwa
articles.text: n'ibihugu byose.

articles.heading: (a) Ibihugu bishobora kuba ibihuriye kuri aya Masezerano hakoreshejwe
articles.text:
(i) umukono hadategerejwe kuyemera;
(ii) umukono hategerejwe kuyemera
gukurikirwa n’ibindi; cyangwa
(iii) kuyemera nta kindi kibikurikiye.
(b) Kwemera Amasezerano kugira agaciro
hatanzwe inyandiko ibigenewe ishyikirizwa
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye.

articles.heading: Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa iyo ibihugu makumyabiri na bitandatu mu bigize Umuryango w'Abibumbye bizaba byemeye
articles.text:
kuba ibiyahuriyeho hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n'ingingo ya 79.

articles.heading: Hakurikijwe ingingo ya 102 y'Amasezerano mpuzamahanga ashyiraho Umuryango w'Abibumbye, Umunyamabanga mukuru
articles.text:
w'Umuryango w'Abibumbye yandika aya
Masezerano iyo yashyizweho umukono
hadategerejwe kwemerwa n’igihugu kimwe
cyangwa mu gihe hatangwa inyandiko ya mbere
yo kuyemera.

articles.heading: Umunyamabanga Mukuru w'Umuryango w'Abibumbye amenyesha ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano itariki y’itangira gukurikizwa

BAMAZE KWEMERA IBIKUBIYE MURI
AYA MASEZERANO, abahagarariye ibihugu
byabo babiherewe ububasha bayashyizeho
umukono.
Bikorewe mu mujyi wa New York kuri uyu wa
22 Nyakanga 1946, mu nyandiko imwe iri mu
ndimi z'Igishinwa, Icyongereza, Igifaransa,
Ikirusiya n'Icyesupanyolo, kandi buri nyandiko
inganya agaciro n’indi. Inyandiko
y’umwimerere ibikwa mu ishyinguranyandiko
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye.
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye yoherereza inyandukuro ihuje
n’umwimerere buri Guverinoma yari
ihagarariwe mu Nama.
